card.name: Words about guidance and recommendations
card.fires_on: The word that completes a reference to guidance, such as recommendations, guidelines, or a statement, or the end of a society name like SOGC. Also "reasonable" in "it is reasonable to expect".

modes.label: Guidance nouns
modes.description: Recommendations, guidelines, or a statement from a medical body.
modes.example: For co-administration with drospirenone, clinical monitoring is recommended due to the potential for hyperkalemia. No data are available to make<< recommendations>> on co-administration with other hormonal contrace

modes.label: It is reasonable to expect
modes.description: "Reasonable" in the stock phrase about expecting a similar risk with a related drug.
modes.example: odiazepines increases the risk of drug-related mortality compared to use of opioid analgesics alone. Because of similar pharmacological properties, it is<< reasonable>> to expect similar risk with the concom

modes.label: Medical society names
modes.description: The last letter of a professional society acronym before talk of guidance.
modes.example: National Organization for Rare Diseases The Canadian Women's Health Network The Society of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists of Canada (SOG<<C>>) ACOG issues guidance on the treatment
